records.product: Management Tools - AWS CloudTrail Data Events Recorded
Management Tools - AWS CloudTrail Data Events Recorded

terms.quote: Amazon S3 storage usage is calculated in binary gigabytes (GB)
rules: S3 billed GB = 1073741824 bytes.
IA minimum: 128 KiB/object and 30 days. Glacier Instant: 128 KiB and 90 days. Flexible: 40 KiB metadata and 90 days. Deep Archive: 40 KiB metadata and 180 days.
DELETE/CANCEL have no request fee; list/HEAD/multipart/retrieval need individual mappings.
Restore staging, noncurrent versions and unfinished parts also occupy storage.
PendingDeletion has no key-storage fee unless deletion is cancelled.
First two rotations add storage cost; later rotations are capped.
The request allowance is shared globally and kept separate from gross usage.
Selected Linux on-demand instance billed per second. Disks, IPv4 and CPU credits are separate.
Internet tiers aggregate across named services/regions; an account-wide allowance must not be applied per venue.

terms.quote: one-second increments with a 10-minute minimum charge
rules: Selected instance price excludes allocated disk, IOPS/throughput, excess backup storage, transfer and extended support.
Multi-AZ rate already covers the named deployment; do not multiply it as another standby.

terms.quote: Each partial NAT Gateway-hour consumed is billed as a full hour.
rules: NAT processing and internet transfer are separate charges for a mapped traffic path.
Gateway-type S3 endpoints have no hourly or processing fee; interface endpoints are separate.

terms.quote: Pricing is calculated per second with a 1-minute minimum.
rules: Billable time starts at image download. CPU and memory quantities are requested resources.
20 GB scratch included; price only excess. No proof that the gateway can run in this packaging.
Hosted zones are global. Monthly creation charges are not hourly.
No-charge alias queries require an eligible AWS target; do not apply to arbitrary venue records.

terms.quote: There is no additional charge for Amazon ECS orchestration.
rules: Ordinary ECS EC2/Fargate incur underlying-resource charges. Managed Instances add a management fee.
IAM credentials do not remove the costs of the resources they access.
Each primary-billing-view physical request costs USD0.01; custom views charge per source. Count retries/pages.

terms.quote: Each partial Application Load Balancer hour used is billed as a full hour.
rules: ALB/NLB hourly charge rounds partial hours up. Capacity units use the limiting dimensions, measured per minute.
IPv4 and directional transfer remain separate.

unavailable.reason: No regional Price List entry; current SES endpoint table also omits Spain.

gaps: Alternative-class retrieval/transition, cross-zone transfer, WAF, support, domain renewal, Parameter Store, additional orchestration modes and external API fees remain unpriced.
Non-S3 GB byte definitions need explicit sources before conversion.
Runtime/version availability and instance capacity are unvalidated.
SES attachment transfer dimensions remain unpriced; Stockholm SES is a candidate, with no provider choice implied.
S3 request failure billing and transfer paths need operation-specific mappings before the live preflight.
No discount, free allowance, credit, VAT, foreign exchange or measured workload is included in these gross rates.
Fargate one-minute minimum applies to task duration, multiplied by requested CPU/memory; scalar usage minimum/rounding stay unknown until Task 2 maps durations.

external.reason: Standard Linux paid minutes before included allowances; monthly quantity unknown.
Cloud registry uses shared compute/database; no external API price has been established.
